newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai January WPI rises 3.0 percent yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thai January WPI rises 3.0 percent yr/yr.

text.p: Thailand's January wholesale prices index rose 3.0 percent year-on-year and 0.1 percent over December 1996, the commerce ministry said in a statement on Thursday.
The commerce ministry said the WPI rise was due to increasing prices of industrial goods such as petroleum products, textile, machinery and parts.
It also noted that the prices of food and agricultural products, except for rice and paddy which were supported by strong exports, eased 0.1 percent as more supplies entered the market.
Building materials dropped 0.1 percent from December but rose 0.4 percent year-on-year. The rise was small due to a continued slump in the property sector, the ministry said.
